# Data contracts

Entity and field contracts for the database layer (GOV-03). Source of truth:
[db/contracts/entities.json](../../db/contracts/entities.json), verified against the live schema by
`packages/platform/test/db/contracts.db.test.ts`. Field classification drives audit and log redaction today;
field-level access enforcement (RBAC-04) is later work.

## Classifications

| Class | Meaning |
|---|---|
| `public` | Visible to anyone in the tenant with access to the record type (e.g. directory names). |
| `employee` | Visible to the employee concerned and to roles granted the record type. |
| `hr-restricted` | HR, security and explicitly granted roles only. |
| `payroll-restricted` | Payroll/finance roles only. |
| `medical` | Authorized health handlers only. |

## Retention classes

Periods are not decided yet (see docs/phase-0/open-questions.md). Nothing is deleted automatically.

| Class | Meaning |
|---|---|
| `tenant-account` | Life of the customer contract plus the offboarding retention period (SAS-03, SAS-04). Period: not yet decided. |
| `identity-access` | Access records kept for security review after revocation. Period: not yet decided. |
| `employment-record` | Personnel history retained after employment ends per the legal pack and tenant policy (NFR-05, DOC-17). Period: comes from an approved pack, none exists yet. |
| `audit-trail` | Per audit category within legal minimums, with legal hold (AUD-07). Period: not yet decided. |
| `operational-transient` | Delivery/processing bookkeeping; purge after completion window. Period: not yet decided. |
| `product-catalogue` | Product-versioned reference data; kept while referenced. |
| `schema-metadata` | Kept for the life of the database. |
| `authentication` | Credentials, MFA secrets and sessions: kept while the account exists; sessions and challenges purged after expiry plus a security review window. Period: not yet decided. |
